mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 61 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park under a waxing gibbous moon, with an overnight low of 57 degrees and no rain in the forecast. If you are a night owl, you can catch the International Space Station passing high in the sky tomorrow morning at 3:25 AM, traveling from Mount Horeb toward the Madison area.

The Verona Police Department released its weekly recap covering August 17 through August 24, highlighting various incidents including arrests, traffic crashes, and drug investigations, though no new important city emails were received today.

We have a packed schedule starting tomorrow with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and yoga. On Tuesday, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market will be held at Hometown Junction Park.

On August 22, officers were called to Enterprise Drive regarding a vehicle versus parked vehicle crash, which resulted in several citations including inattentive driving and failure to install an ignition interlock device.

Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch, but since the shop is currently closed, you can stop by when they open tomorrow at 10 AM to grab a scoop or try the OREO Cookie Cheesecake flavor.
